You've Taken the First Step Toward Understanding Peripheral Vascular/Arterial Disease (PVD/PAD)
Thanks for taking time to download the Peripheral Vascular/Arterial Disease (PVD/PAD) Patient Guide. In it, you'll learn more about the condition and how patients like you or your loved one manage it.
From causes to treatments, symptoms to surgery, the guide can provide a foundation to better understand PVD/PAD and give you an idea of any next steps you may need to take to ensure your health and wellness.
Still need more information? Your team at Orlando Health Heart Institute is always available to talk – in person or over the phone – to help you understand anything that may seem confusing or to answer any questions you have after reading the guide.
